title: CXL → Endur ETRM Migration
problem: Uniper's North American trading desks ran on a legacy CXL ETRM system. Migrating to Endur meant rebuilding the entire data flow — ingestion through business-ready reporting — without interrupting trading.
approach: Architected the full Snowflake and Azure data flow, built incremental DBT models handling deduplication, re-ranking and clustering keys, and took the platform live including RBAC, QA and data-governance sign-off.

title: Market Data Ingestion Platform
problem: Market data arrived from Morningstar, AESO, Genscape and ARGUS in inconsistent shapes, and a slow daily sync plus silent schema drift meant corrupt data could reach reporting unnoticed.
approach: Centralised every provider behind ADF pipelines, added Snowpipe ingestion with dynamic schema-drift handling, and parallelised batch transfers with a custom Azure Function App for drift detection and corrupt-data alerting.

title: Pharma Go-to-Market Analytics
problem: The largest US pharma client needed go-to-market reporting across 300+ KPIs, built on a healthcare dataset large enough that naive processing could not keep up with the reporting cycle.
approach: Built and oversaw ETL on Snowflake and Dataiku DSS, optimised ingestion, and translated client requirements into automated dashboards with weekly QA/QC gates.

title: Tableau Automation Framework
problem: Downloading data extracts, comparing dashboards and adjusting sheet visibility was manual work that consumed analyst days every reporting cycle.
approach: Wrote a Python framework over the Tableau REST API that automated extract downloads, dashboard comparison and sheet visibility, with XML manipulation driven by a centralised config file.
